process_note: Second course under the funnel refinement: five directions per series at round one, narrowed to three under reactive constraints at round two, one preregistration-shaped lead plus named runner-up and unpriced residual risk at round three. Occupied-ground disclosure staged at round two. Series staggered: a later series' round one alongside an earlier series' later rounds; exclusions drawn from round-one territory.
exclusion_note: series 2 round 1 excluded series 1's entire round-one territory (five directions, one abstract line each); series 3 round 1 excluded both prior series' round-one territories (ten lines). Exclusion text is embedded in the hashed r1 prompts above. Occupied ground disclosed at round two additionally covered the fifteen v0.16 course directions, the adjudicated retraction-closure territory, the spent veto census, and the frozen resolver.

series_1: ledger-first claims -- published sentences emitted from typed artifact citations, blast radius read not recovered
mutation corps -- preregistered stranger-authored defect catalogues per gate with catch-rate floors
the refusal census -- refusal behavior scored against constructed answerability, both error directions
the kill floor -- hardened hostile-input intake where nothing uncertified exits, yield measured
twenty questions -- learned clarifying-question selection against exact answer-set reduction in sealed worlds
series_2: second machine -- cross-environment determinism with exactly enumerated divergences
two referees -- a second refusal instrument from a provenance-disjoint ontology source
unless-receipts -- constructive refusals carrying exhaustively computed minimal assumption sets
wild text -- external validity of the exact parser on licensed prose written outside the program
nothing vanishes -- a mechanized goal ledger with terminal states, outsider-checkable
series_3: half-life -- temporal validity against moving upstream vintages, staleness as a refusal ground
antibody -- scope-local internal contradiction census under exactly-checkable relations
detached receipt -- one answer re-verified from its receipt alone, no program code
audit clock -- verification cost of a published claim, measured in minutes
residual ledger -- model-blind ablation publishing where the code/weights split falls per family
round_one_funnel.disclosed_drift: series 2 disclosed and replaced two drafts (claim expiry toward series 1's ledger-first; library mutation toward series 1's mutation corps); series 3 disclosed and replaced one (a live retraction fire-drill toward series 1's ledger-first) and flagged half-life's boundary with wild text

series_1.lead: ledger-first claims -- claims/<release>.claims.jsonl with typed citations, radius certificate against the surviving instruments, the voided scan demoted to a completeness linter, gate proposed as L1-L11 and landed as L1-L13 after adversarial review (L6 replaced by a path-token control the original precision clause could not falsify; L12 purity imported from series 3; L13 exploratory floor added at grounding), the recheck's trust priced by stranger-authored mutants
series_1.runner_up: mutation corps (priced inside the lead as clauses L7/L8/L10)
series_1.merged: refusal census and twenty questions merged into 'the negative space' (construction-fact answerability labels); kill floor dropped, its machine-stranger mechanism reused as an authorship channel
series_1.residual_risk: a citation that resolves to an artifact containing the value rather than the artifact the claim rests on survives every clause; pricing it requires premise-necessity, which is parked ground

series_2.lead: unless-receipts -- reading the 996 recorded refusal edges into constructive refusals with recompile-verified complete and minimal assumption sets, gate U1-U9, constant-alphabet and nearest-k controls
series_2.runner_up: two referees (rebuilt as source-disjointness of the kind ontology; dimension-vector-only control could void the menu itself)
series_2.folded: second machine reduced to an environment-matrix checklist line; nothing vanishes parked behind the working manual audit with a named unpark condition
series_2.residual_risk: unless-sets can be exactly right about the compiler and wrong about the world; no oracle outside the world prices fidelity under one maintainer

series_3.lead: detached receipt -- a frozen receipt grammar and a stranger-authored checker that replays 50 answers with no program imports, purity clause D3, vintage rider for licensed lexical currency
series_3.runner_up: residual ledger (inference-only model-blind ablation; per-family budgets, no aggregate number by refusal)
series_3.dropped: audit clock (its checkable salvage is series 1's mechanism; its native output is testimony, not an artifact); half-life folded into the lead as the vintage parameter; antibody kept to round three's door but ranked behind on effort variance, with the scope-machinery probe named as the fact that would reorder
series_3.residual_risk: spec and emitter share an author; a mutually held error replays green -- the gate certifies self-containment while reading as if it certified correctness

selection.convergence_note: the program's own void post-mortem named 'citation discipline at authoring time' before this course ran; series 1 proposed it independently at round one and series 2 and 3 each disclosed and replaced drafts that drifted toward it. Four independent arrivals at one direction is the strongest convergence the course format has produced.
selection.imports: from series 3: the purity constraint (claims records checkable without program imports) as one clause; from series 2: the environment-matrix checklist line on the shipped artifact, and unless-receipts preserved whole as the sealed-worlds successor with its complete preregistration quoted in the design's declined section
